FN-B0CXJQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 201
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry Underwood
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 201 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board for Registration of
Architects until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
